Race.description: Standard human race. Used for Empire, Vampire Counts (living), Chaos mortals.
Bretonnian humans - peasants and knights of Bretonnia.
Chaos Marauders - Norscan and tribal warriors of Chaos.
Cultists devoted to Chaos Undivided.
Undead vampires - lords of the night.
Elven race - Wood Elves, High Elves.
Dwarfs of the Karaz Ankor.
Orcs - larger, stronger greenskins.
Goblins - smaller, more cunning greenskins.
Animated skeletal warriors.
Incorporeal undead spirits (Cairn Wraiths, Tomb Banshees).
Swarms of tormented spirits.
Lesser beastmen, often used as skirmishers.
True beastmen, the warriors of the herd.
Massive bull-headed beastmen.
Regenerating monsters found throughout the Old World.
Large monster body type (Giants, Crypt Horrors, etc.).
Medium monster body type (Varghulfs, Rat Ogres, etc.).
Large, brutish creatures from the Mountains of Mourn.
Massive humanoids.
